latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of One Video AI — Create One Edited Video Fast

- Instantly polishes raw video footage into a single edited video via cloud GPU backend (supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- Fully automatic onboarding: anonymous token generation, session setup, and connection status messaging.
- Seamless actions for upload, credits inquiry, status checking, and export — all accessible through natural language prompts.
- 1–2 minute turnaround time for most videos; exports in 1080p MP4 format.
- Provides robust error handling, session management, and real-time progress updates.
